name: Annihilation Protocol
summary: Destroyer Cult or Flayed Ones units re-roll charge rolls, gaining +1 as well against half-strength targets; Destroyer Cult ranged attacks on the closest eligible target get +1 Armour Penetration.

name: Command Protocols
summary: While led by a Necrons Character, a unit's attacks get +1 to hit.

name: Technosorcerous Augmentations
summary: Cryptek ranged weapons gain Assault. When a Cryptek unit shoots, pick one of Anti-Infantry 3+, Anti-Mounted 4+, Assault, Heavy, or Ignores Cover for its weapons that phase.

name: Cold Fervour
summary: Destroyer Cult weapons get +2 Strength. The first time each turn a Destroyer Cult unit destroys or reduces a unit below half-strength, other Necrons models (excluding Destroyer Cult, Monster, Titanic) also get +2 Strength for the turn.

name: Hyperphasing
summary: At the end of your opponent's turn, remove a battle-size-limited number of unengaged Necrons units from the battlefield into Strategic Reserves.

name: Worthy Foes
summary: Each Command phase, mark one enemy unit; Noble, Lychguard, and Triarch attacks against it get +1 to wound until your next Command phase.

name: Cosmic Distortion
summary: Necrons Monster units give enemies within 6" +1 Armour Penetration taken against them; a Monster can suffer 3 mortal wounds to extend that range to 9" for the phase. Each such Monster costs extra points for this ability.

name: Empowered Engines
summary: Friendly Necrons Titanic Fly units get +6" Move. Exclusive Hypercrypt-tagged detachment.
